Messages.Author: direwolf
Messages.Body:
Ashes in the Hands

Only one Ashes in the Hands may be played each game.
Each Methuselah discards his or her hand and burns one pool for each card less than discarded by his or her predator.

Compelling game need:
This is a vote that in most cases doesn't do much, but could contribute to a larger strategy. Combined with cards like Meddling of Semsith, Year of Fortune, Dreams of the Sphinx, Visit from the Capuchin you could have some interesting results.

Independent Futurist. Contrarian (titled, X votes where X is the number of votes as the acting minion.) Target Vitals is always the better combat card.
